summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built custom CUDA C++ kernels for GPU-optimized inference (1.5-2x speedup over TorchScript) and applied 8-bit quantization to compress a 1.1B parameter language model by ~55% GPU memory footprint with under 1% accuracy loss. Experience spans PyTorch model training and evaluation, transformer architectures implemented from scratch, and distributed workload scaling across SLURM-managed clusters via MPI.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built PyTorch preprocessing/training pipelines via HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; improved validation accuracy 55% to 93%.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 images achieving 83% mAP@50; exported to ONNX/TFLite for deployment.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory buffers.
Achieved 1.5-2x speedup (49.2ms vs 77.5ms CPU TorchScript) in convolution ops with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled VRAM and latency via pynvml.
Benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, ARC — under 1% accuracy degradation, near-lossless compression.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for real-time visual servoing — 5.2x inference speedup (56.7 to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS) over eager PyTorch.
Built a distributed three-layer pipeline (Flutter, Flask-SocketIO, Jetson+Arduino) achieving 100% pick reliability at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch — multi-head attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, weight tying.
Built a custom tokenizer and training loop; validated autoregressive text generation on a fantasy-themed corpus.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers on a SLURM-managed cluster.
Achieved 10.49x speedup with 12 workers; showed up to 65% degradation under uneven load distribution.
